correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact weak-2 constraint, the Moore-Penrose inverse on the zero-sum hyperplane, the QLQ frame, both sharp inequalities and equality iff edge half-resistances uniform. Critical weighted spectral Cauchy--Schwarz gives the upper estimate with no unproved lemma. Connectedness handles the single zero eigenvalue; n=2 works. Strongly regular algebra proves uniformity independently of graph automorphisms. Standalone numerical code checked 87 uniform-edge test graphs including a Chang switch and one nonuniform path; numerical checks are not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: A general sharp spectral two-sided inequality and complete equality classification for a natural graph-gradient operator-ideal norm, with explicit norming family and non-edge-transitive strongly regular examples. This provides structural insight into when a Laplacian trace computes a Banach-space norm, subsuming but going substantially beyond the previously known complete-bipartite special case. Mathematically motivated, not an arbitrary finite census.
